h1: What Is an AI Interview Copilot and How Does It Work?

author: Amigo Team

html:
An AI interview copilot is a real-time AI assistant that runs on your computer during a live job interview. It listens to what the interviewer says, transcribes it instantly, and streams AI-generated answer suggestions that you can use to guide your response, all in under 200 milliseconds.

Think of it as having a brilliant colleague whispering answers in your ear, but through software rather than an earpiece. Unlike interview prep apps or mock interview simulators, a copilot works during the actual interview, not just before it.

Copilot vs Practice Tool: The Critical Difference

Most AI tools marketed as "interview coaches" are really practice simulators. They let you run mock interviews on your own time, then give feedback. That is useful, but it stops the moment you enter the real interview.

Practice tools (FinalRound, etc.)

  • Used before the interview
  • Simulated questions only
  • Feedback after you answer
  • Stops at the interview door

AI Copilot (Amigo)

  • Active during the live interview
  • Real interviewer's actual questions
  • Real-time streamed answers
  • Excluded from screen capture

How Does an AI Interview Copilot Work?

Here is what happens in the seconds between an interviewer asking a question and Amigo displaying an answer:

1

Audio capture

Amigo captures your system audio locally using platform audio APIs. No data is sent externally during capture; it stays on your machine. The interviewer's voice comes through your speakers or headphones, and Amigo picks it up.

2

Voice activity detection

A voice activity detector (VAD) identifies when the interviewer stops speaking. This triggers the transcription step immediately, with no waiting for a timeout.

3

Real-time transcription

The captured audio is sent to Deepgram's speech-to-text API, which returns a transcript typically within milliseconds. Interim results appear even before the interviewer finishes their sentence.

4

AI answer generation

The transcript is sent to an LLM (OpenAI's models) along with your personalized context: your resume, the job description, and any preparation notes you loaded. The model streams back a tailored answer.

5

Answer display

Words appear on your Amigo overlay one by one, just like ChatGPT's streaming output. You read it, adapt it in your own voice, and deliver your answer to the interviewer.

What Makes Amigo Different?

Beyond the technical pipeline, Amigo has two features that no other AI interview tool has:

🛡️ OS-level stealth

Amigo's window is excluded from screen capture at the operating system level. When you share your screen, it is literally not there. Zoom, Teams, and Meet cannot see it.

👥 Human Buddy

Share an invite link with a trusted friend, mentor, or coach. They see your live interview transcript in real-time and can send you hints, reactions, and messages that only you see. AI plus a real human, simultaneously.
